log_level.description: Logging verbosity: debug, info, warning, error, or critical

max_workers.description: Maximum number of concurrent speech synthesis workers

timeout_ms.description: Maximum time (in milliseconds) allowed for a synthesis request

max_buffer_size.description: Maximum buffer size (in bytes) for audio output

backend.host.description: Hostname or IP address of the backend speech server

backend.port.description: Port number for the backend server API

speech.engine.description: Speech synthesis engine to use (e.g., espeak, mbrola, freephone, ru_tts, user); default per manpage is 'espeak'

speech.default_language.description: Default language code (e.g., en, ru, de, fr, es, pt, it, autodetect)

speech.voices.description: List of available voices, each with configuration parameters; per manpage only espeak/mbrola/freephone/ru_tts/user are valid engines; gender/stability/similarity_boost are not part of official spec — retained for compatibility but ignored by actual multispeech

audio.sample_rate.description: Audio sample rate in Hz; manpage default for tone sampling is 44100 but for generic audio output no fixed sample_rate is documented — this field likely misplaces tone.sampling into audio. Still retained as de facto standard.

audio.output_format.description: Output audio format: wav, mp3, or opus — *not* documented in official manpage. Multispeech uses raw PCM via ALSA/DSP; format is typically inferred from device. Retained for compatibility.

audio.enable_denoising.description: Enable or disable post-processing noise reduction — *not* documented in official manpage. Removed default; default should be false.

logging.file.description: Path to the main log file — *not* documented; multispeech logs only via stdout/stderr or syslog when run as module. Retained for compatibility.

logging.max_size_mb.description: Maximum log file size in MB before rotation — *not* documented. Removed.

logging.max_backup_count.description: Number of rotated log files to retain — *not* documented. Removed.

frontend.native_voices.description: Enable native voice control (Emacspeak-style inline commands); per manpage: 'yes' or 'on' enables, 'no' or 'off' disables. Default: yes.

frontend.dtk_voices.description: Enable DECtalk voice control inline commands; per manpage: default is disabled.
